rigs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D game cutout animation rig atlas, NOT an animation sequence and NOT an assembled character. Input image 1 is a STYLE AND CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY. Create a new square 1536x1536 PNG with genuine alpha transparency. Exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, 9 equal 512x512 cells. Each cell contains ONLY the named isolated body part centered, with at least 60 pixels completely transparent padding on all four sides. No assembled character, no second part in a cell, no grid lines, no labels, no text, no shadows, no backdrop. Painted cartoon game art matching the reference: bold dark-plum outline, soft rich cel shading, expressive chibi horror, consistent mint, violet, ivory and warm amber palette. This will be articulated by the engine; arms and leg segments must be STRAIGHT VERTICAL with the proximal joint at the top and distal joint at the bottom, round overlap ends, NOT bent action poses. Head is three-quarter profile looking RIGHT. Torso has no head, no arms, no legs. Every part is physically disconnected from its neighbours. Preserve character identity but redraw clean animation-ready parts. Layout, left to right: top row HEAD including a little neck, TORSO ending at hips, UPPER ARM shoulder to elbow (no hand); middle row FOREARM elbow to wrist (no hand), HAND with short wrist, THIGH hip to knee; bottom row SHIN knee to ankle (no foot), FOOT facing RIGHT with a little ankle, SPECIAL ACCESSORY. Do not substitute a whole leg for thigh or shin. Bare arms have skin shading matching the head. Very clear production sprite edges, no cropped parts. Subject is the GREEN ZOMBIE from the first row of the reference, wild black-purple hair, enormous orange eyes, cheeky smile, ragged violet short sleeve shirt, brown torn shorts, green bare limbs and bare three-toed foot. Head must contain the hair and eyes but no torso. Thigh includes a short torn brown shorts cuff at its proximal end. SPECIAL ACCESSORY is one detached small violet torn fabric ribbon.

parallax: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent parallax background atlas for the same cartoon horror runner. Input image 1 is a style/palette reference only. Create a new 1536x1024 landscape PNG on TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY, exactly 3 horizontally spanning landscape strips stacked in 3 separate equal-height rows. Each strip is 1536 pixels wide and lives only in its own 341-pixel-high row, with at least 30 pixels transparent space above and below its artwork so rows never touch. No sky background, no moon, no characters, no UI, no text, no grid. Top strip: distant muted lavender rolling hills, conifer silhouettes and a small crooked castle with sparse warm amber windows, soft distant contrast. Middle strip: a richly painted continuous haunted village skyline with varied Victorian houses, pointed roofs, stone arch bridge, cemetery wall and softly glowing golden windows, lavender plum and muted teal, no trees taller than row. Bottom strip: nearer crooked bare trees, wrought iron fences, gravestones and a few pumpkin lanterns, dark plum silhouettes with mint moonlight on edges, sparse trees leave wide transparent views between them. Each row is a SEPARATE sideways scrolling layer and must fit completely inside its own band. The left and right edges of each strip join naturally for horizontal tiling. Match reference cartoon brushwork, proportions and restrained scary-cute atmosphere. Keep equal gutters clear and avoid any part crossing from one strip to another.
